# ECN-2026-049 - Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HP03

Reason for change
- Background: Recent maintenance reviews on EQ-P2-L4-HP03 identified variability in cylinder performance and increased incidence of seal replacement. Root cause analysis linked the variability to lubricant supply inconsistency and a history of mixed-use lubricants from multiple batches. To standardize reliability and simplify inventory traceability, the lubrication specification for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 is being formalized.
- Objective: Specify a single approved lubricant part number and update related procedural documents to ensure consistent application, storage, and recordkeeping for EQ-P2-L4-HP03.
- Scope of change: This ECN applies only to the hydraulic forging press identified as EQ-P2-L4-HP03 on P2-L4. It does not change mechanical design, control logic, safety interlocks, or production parameters.

Affected items
- Equipment affected: EQ-P2-L4-HP03 (Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3).
- Consumable change: The lubricant part number for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is CFW-LUB-450. CFW-LUB-450 is the only approved lubricant to be used on EQ-P2-L4-HP03 going forward.
- Documentation impacted: SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-04, SOP-P2-L4-05 will be updated to reflect the approved lubricant, storage and handling requirements, and inspection checkpoints associated with this ECN.
- Inventory: Existing stock of other lubricants currently dedicated to EQ-P2-L4-HP03 must be dispositioned per existing inventory control procedures; inventory records must clearly mark CFW-LUB-450 as the approved item for EQ-P2-L4-HP03.

Implementation
- Implementation summary: Replace any ambiguous lubricant references in field procedures for EQ-P2-L4-HP03 with CFW-LUB-450. Update SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-04, and SOP-P2-L4-05 to include specific handling, storage, labeling and inspection guidance tied to CFW-LUB-450.
- Step rationale and detailed actions:
  - Procurement and inventory: Purchasing will source CFW-LUB-450 and set the item as preferred stock for line P2-L4. Warehouse personnel will segregate CFW-LUB-450 stock and apply a unique shelf label indicating use for EQ-P2-L4-HP03 only.
  - Labeling and storage: All containers of CFW-LUB-450 shall be labeled with the part number exactly as CFW-LUB-450. Storage area signage will reference P2-L4 and EQ-P2-L4-HP03 to reduce cross-usage risk.
  - Procedural updates: Revision to SOP-P2-L4-02 will add a lubrication checklist item that requires visual verification of container labeling before dispensing. SOP-P2-L4-04 will be adjusted to record the part number CFW-LUB-450 in the maintenance log entry for lubrication events. SOP-P2-L4-05 will include a section on acceptance criteria for lubricant receipt, including container integrity and label verification.
  - Training: Operators and maintenance staff assigned to P2-L4 will receive briefing on the change and demonstration of the new labeling and documentation steps. Training records will be retained in the training file for line P2-L4.
  - Example scenarios:
    - Receipt inspection: Upon receipt, the warehouse inspector compares incoming label to CFW-LUB-450. If the label matches CFW-LUB-450, the item is accepted and entered into inventory for P2-L4. If the label does not match CFW-LUB-450, the item is segregated and escalated.
    - Lubricant dispense: Before dispensing to EQ-P2-L4-HP03, the technician confirms the container label CFW-LUB-450 and records the part number in the maintenance log entry required by SOP-P2-L4-04.
- Records to keep:
  - Purchase order references to CFW-LUB-450 and associated receiving records.
  - Receiving inspection records including container label verification and acceptance notes.
  - Maintenance log entries for EQ-P2-L4-HP03 that contain the lubricant part number CFW-LUB-450 as recorded per SOP-P2-L4-04.
  - Training attendance records demonstrating instruction on use of CFW-LUB-450 for EQ-P2-L4-HP03.
  - Disposition records for any previously used lubricants removed from EQ-P2-L4-HP03 service.
  - Revised SOP documents: SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-04, SOP-P2-L4-05 with revision notes referencing this ECN.
- Exceptions and controls: Any temporary deviation from use of CFW-LUB-450 requires documented approval from the maintenance manager and must reference this ECN in the deviation record. Deviation records become part of the equipment file.

Approvals
- Approval path: Maintenance Engineering, Quality Assurance, Production Lead for P2-L4, and Procurement must review and sign. Quality will confirm that SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-04, and SOP-P2-L4-05 have been updated and stored in document control.
- Post-implementation verification: Quality Assurance will perform an audit of EQ-P2-L4-HP03 records to verify that CFW-LUB-450 is being used and recorded according to the updated SOPs. Audit findings will be attached to the ECN file.
- Related documents: See SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-04, SOP-P2-L4-05 for procedural detail and recordkeeping templates.

Revision note: This ECN Rev D formalizes CFW-LUB-450 as the approved lubricant for EQ-P2-L4-HP03 and mandates coordinated updates to the listed SOPs and retention of associated records.
